_metadata.description: Banned and recalled ingredients with regulatory basis

recalled_ingredients.reason: Cardiovascular risks including hypertension, tachycardia, myocardial infarction, and sudden cardiac death
recalled_ingredients.warning_message: Ephedra and its alkaloids are banned by the FDA due to serious cardiovascular risks.

recalled_ingredients.reason: Aristolochic acid causes aristolochic acid nephropathy (AAN) and urothelial cancer
recalled_ingredients.warning_message: Aristolochia and aristolochic acid-containing products are banned due to carcinogenic risk.

recalled_ingredients.reason: Rare but severe liver injury; hepatotoxicity in healthy individuals
recalled_ingredients.warning_message: Kava has been associated with rare cases of liver damage. Consumers with liver disease should avoid.

recalled_ingredients.reason: Pyrrolizidine alkaloids cause hepatotoxicity and may increase cancer risk
recalled_ingredients.warning_message: Comfrey contains pyrrolizidine alkaloids linked to liver damage and potential cancer risk.

recalled_ingredients.reason: Androgenic steroid precursor; metabolized to testosterone and other steroids
recalled_ingredients.warning_message: Androstenedione is banned as a controlled steroid precursor.

recalled_ingredients.reason: Synthetic anabolic steroid used in athletic doping
recalled_ingredients.warning_message: THG is a banned anabolic steroid.

recalled_ingredients.reason: Phenylbutazone causes agranulocytosis and aplastic anemia in humans
recalled_ingredients.warning_message: Phenylbutazone is banned due to serious hematologic risks.

recalled_ingredients.reason: Can elevate blood pressure, increase heart rate, and cause anxiety and tremor
recalled_ingredients.warning_message: Yohimbe may cause hypertension and cardiac effects. Individuals with hypertension should avoid.

recalled_ingredients.reason: Inorganic germanium salts cause irreversible kidney damage and renal failure
recalled_ingredients.warning_message: Germanium supplements may cause kidney damage and should be avoided.

recalled_ingredients.reason: Some traditional Asian herbal products contain aristolochia species
recalled_ingredients.warning_message: Some traditional Chinese medicines may contain aristolochia and pose cancer risk.

recalled_ingredients.reason: Linked to heart problems, high blood pressure, and psychiatric events
recalled_ingredients.warning_message: DMAA is banned due to cardiovascular safety risks.

recalled_ingredients.reason: Contains pyrrolizidine alkaloids causing liver damage
recalled_ingredients.warning_message: Coltsfoot may cause liver damage and should not be used without medical supervision.

recalled_ingredients.reason: Specific batches found to contain lead above safe limits
recalled_ingredients.warning_message: Certain chromium picolinate batches contain elevated lead levels. Verify batch number.
